notes: Build a herringbone parquet floor occupying a 2.4 x 1.8 m rectangle in world XY (with Z up, base at Z = 0). Planks are 0.2 x 0.8 x 0.015 m and all instance nodes must reference one shared component definition. The pattern is rotated 45 deg to world axes: planks alternate between +45 deg and -45 deg (i.e. their long axes lie along world-X+world-Y and world-X-world-Y). Each plank's short end meets the long edge of a perpendicular neighbour so the pattern shows the classic herringbone V-shapes. The overall plank collection must fit inside the 2.4 x 1.8 m rectangle (approximately within 10 cm tolerance). Expected count: at least 18 planks, roughly half at each orientation.
